summary.text: Briscoe Cain is a member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 128 and lives in Deer Park. He serves on the Agriculture & Livestock and Delivery of Government Efficiency committees and previously chaired the Agriculture & Livestock and Elections committees.

paragraphs.text: Cain grew up in Deer Park, graduated from Deer Park High School, attended San Jacinto College and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Houston-Downtown and a J.D. from South Texas College of Law.
He owns the Law Office of Briscoe Cain, PLLC, and is a captain in the Texas State Guard.
His page says that in 2021 he authored and passed legislation preventing social media companies from banning users based on political viewpoints.
He and his wife, Bergundi, have five sons.
